newsitem.title: INDIA: Three hurt in explosions in Indian capital.
newsitem.headline: Three hurt in explosions in Indian capital.

text.p: Two explosions in crowded markets in the Indian capital on Friday injured three people but there was no serious property damage, police said.
They said a tin containing iron rivets exploded in a roadside hawker's cart in the Sadar Bazar wholesale market at 1.30 p.m. (0800 GMT). Three people suffered minor injuries.
The other explosion also occurred near a roadside hawker in the busy Nai Sarak area at 2.15 p.m (0845 GMT). Nobody was injured in that incident, police said.
They said the explosive material was the same in both incidents.
